abi.termination: RET 0x4 at 0x006a250c, 0x006a252a, and the parent tail path

layout_evidence.identity_boundary: The returned runtime object is the property value at entry+0x04. It is not the PropertyList's conceptual ResourceKey and is not a cache identity.

mechanics.lookup: Read the same map span and lookup mode as HasProperty and call the shared lower-bound helper 0x00612db0. The helper count is the byte distance between entries_begin and entries_end divided by 0x18 before its binary search.
mechanics.hit: Return the address entry+0x04 when the lower-bound result is not the end sentinel and property_id is not less than the entry key.
mechanics.parent: On a local miss, if parent is non-null, tail-dispatch through parent vtable +0x28 with the original property_id and return its Property* result. The parent port is a one-stack-word __thiscall boundary: ECX is the parent receiver, property_id is at ESP+0x04, and the callee cleans 4 bytes.
mechanics.no_parent_sentinel: When both the local map and parent are absent, return the live global sentinel address 0x016027d0 rather than null.
mechanics.sentinel: The map end pointer rejects a lower-bound miss; the no-parent result sentinel is a distinct runtime object boundary and is not interpreted as a valid property.

evidence.observation: The body returns entry+1 on a map hit, delegates a miss to the parent, and returns the global 0x016027d0 sentinel when no parent exists.
The assembly proves the map offsets, the helper's byte-distance/0x18 count, end-sentinel check, entry+0x04 return, the one-word thiscall parent port at +0x28, sentinel address, and RET 0x4.
The only direct named callee is the shared lower-bound helper at 0x00612db0.
The function has one direct call xref and one data xref.
The live type is 56 bytes with the map at +0x18 and parent at +0x30.
The conceptual key remains a separate 12-byte value at list+0x08.

unresolved_questions: Concrete parent PropertyList subtype and vtable +0x28 implementation
Runtime contents and ownership of the global 0x016027d0 sentinel object
Whether callers distinguish the no-parent sentinel from a valid property pointer
blockers: The parent virtual dispatch and sentinel object contents are outside the selected body.
No original runtime trace validates returned property lifetime or sentinel use.
